# Infographic: Small Property


Download Kinsale’s[Small Property Infographic](https://www.kinsaleins.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/SmallProperty_Infographic.pdf) to help you understand the insurance solutions we offer small and mid-sized risks that need coverage up to $5.5M in total Insurable value (TIV). Deductibles start at $500. The facility will provide coverage for a wide variety of occupancies, including **cannabis, daycare facilities, offices, vacant buildings** , and many more classes. We can consider All Risk and Single Peril coverages on a ground-up basis.


We deliver fast responses to a wide variety of occupancies including:


- Auto shops
- Bars & nightclubs
- Convenience stores
- [Cannabis](https://www.kinsaleins.com/cannabis/) -related industries:


- CBD/hemp
- Dispensaries
- Extraction
- Laboratories
- LRO


- Daycares
- Entertainment & media services
- Firearms-related industries:


- Retails shops for firearms & ammunition
- Manufacturers
- Gunsmiths
- Wholesalers


- Hotels & motels
- Houses of worship
- LRO commercial/industrial
- Light manufacturing
- Offices
- Restaurants
- Retail
- Salons
- Small healthcare facilities (non-habitational)
- Vacant buildings
